title: Model aliases get counted as the right models
summary:
Model aliases now get the right usage and price calculations, while Enter gets a clearer dashboard and Hacktoberfest gets a better place to plant app ideas.

Configured aliases now resolve to their service IDs before Enter checks free usage and calculates generation prices. The same work tightened validation for the anonymous, seed, flower, and nectar tiers.

The dashboard gained a collapsible FAQ covering Pollen, trial access, model access, and pricing. Updated branding, typography, and card layouts make balances and API keys easier to scan; the balance now shows two decimal places.

PrisimIG was added to the Creative projects list. It offers several image styles, three output sizes, and batches of up to five images without sign-up or an API key.
